headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2022, back when gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Wardlow vs. Scorpio Sky battled it out in a Street Fight match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.25 ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. It was the 50th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Wardlow fought off interference from Dan Lambert's American Top Team, and three Powerbomb Symphonies later walked out with his first AEW championship.

Back on this day in 2024, Adam Page vs. Jay White met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 8.09 ? one of the better matches of the year. Christian Cage's surprise interference ? a spear on White ? let Page hit the Buckshot Lariat to advance in the Owen Hart Cup semifinals, foreshadowing an alliance to come.

On this day in 2022, Jon Moxley vs. Brody King went to battle over the AEW Interim World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.03 ? a solid showing. For Brody King, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
